استدركوا (form X)
# اِسْتَدْرَكُوا (istadrakū) /is.tad.ra.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# اُسْتُدْرِكُوا (ustudrikū) /us.tud.ri.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# اِسْتَدْرِكُوا (istadrikū) /is.tad.ri.kuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
